terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Static fence panel that tiles post to post. Both faces are seen and nothing is hollow, but nothing opens, turns or swings, so every part is fixed and one root pivot and zero sockets is the correct contract. A level builder places these in runs of dozens, so the draw-call ceiling is the design constraint. ONE POST PER TILE: the post sits on the -X end and the bay runs to the +X edge, so tiles chain post-bay-post-bay along X with no doubled post at a joint. The middle-class house and shophouse fence and the wall of most Bangkok schools. Cream render with rain streaks and black mildew at the base, dark green enamel chipped to rust at the rails, a cracked pier cap.

reasoning: A 0.60 m rendered wall from ONE 0.32 m rendered pier with a slab-and-pyramid cap to the +X edge, and fourteen 0.038 m square steel pickets with diamond spear finials on two 0.06 m flat-bar rails across the bay (proxy: wall full width to 0.33 H, rails at 0.33 and 0.80 H, tips at 0.92 H, pickets at a 5-column 0.19 m pitch, piers 9 columns with caps 11 wide).

Three materials: the wall render with a clustered-mildew canvas, the pier render with a cap-streak canvas (a different STAIN, not a different colour), and a steel whose vertex colour is the rust ENVELOPE under a paint canvas carrying the green as a ratio -- rust is brighter than green and a tile only darkens.
One repetition system: the fourteen pickets as one InstancedMesh.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider on the masonry root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the rhythm of spear pickets over a stained cream wall between capped piers; the pickets have to be geometry with real finials, the staining is canvas.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 3.00 x 1.80 x 0.30 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot and zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The ONLY mechanism this prop has. Static fence geometry: nothing opens, turns or swings, so every part is fixed and gets no axis. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

colliderInventory.note: Declared on the asset as box: one proxy over the whole panel envelope, which is what a run of fence collides as.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

silhouette.description: Wall 2.70 x 0.60 x 0.22 m from the pier to 0.02 m past the tile edge; one pier 0.32 m square to 1.64 m at x -1.31 with a 0.38 x 0.06 m cap slab and a 0.10 m pyramid to 1.80 m; flat-bar rails 0.06 x 0.018 m at 0.70 and 1.44 m; fourteen 38 mm pickets from the wall top to diamond spear tips at 1.65 m at a 0.191 m pitch.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -1.50 at the one pier cap (pier 0.32 m square centred at -1.31, cap 0.38) to +1.52 where the wall and rails run 0.02 m past the tile edge into the next tile's pier; y 0.00 to 1.80 at the cap apex; z -0.19..+0.19 at the cap, the wall at +-0.11. The proxy normalises to w/h 1.627 against the declared 1.667 and d/h 0.213 (0.38 m at the caps, over the declared 0.30 -- the cap is built at 0.38, the proxy's own reading).
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to w/h 1.627, d/h 0.213. Its front depth map (scratch/steel-picket-property-fence/_ev/front.png) shows the wall to 0.33 H, two rails at 0.33 and 0.80 H and spear tips at 0.92 H; the band table against the built model reads mean |delta width| 0.044 and |delta depth| 0.020 of height.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.85: the fence is symmetric front to back; the rails sit 14 mm behind the picket axis, so the back reads rail-in-front.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.91. 852/4,000 triangles, 4/4 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 4/6 unique geometries, three canvases at 3.0 MB, factory ~60 ms. Turntable: the picket bay is open by nature, allowed on measurement; 90/270 are UNSEGMENTABLE by size (pier under the segmenter's 3.5% floor), recorded as a gate limitation of every 3 m panel.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three components and one repetition system: 4 of 4.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 852 of 4,000: boxes, one spike and fourteen instances of one 56-triangle picket.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Tinted boxes for the masonry and rails, a four-sided cone for the pier cap, two flat-shaded 4-segment cylinders for each diamond spear, one InstancedMesh for the pickets.
One InstancedMesh carries the fourteen pickets.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. Three canvases after construction (512, 512 and 256 px), 3.0 MB of texture VRAM, factory ~60 ms.
